opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants – Autumn round
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non‑profit organisations (UK and international) may apply for New Projects & Commissions, Acquisitions & Collections, Conferences, Lectures & Publications, and Long‑Term Research grants. Individuals (sculpture historians, academics, conservators) may apply for Research & Travel grants.
opportunities.summary: Funding for sculpture‑related projects including exhibitions, commissions, acquisitions, conservation, publications, conferences and long‑term research. Grants up to £20,000 (or £5,000 for publications/conferences, £2,500 for research & travel).
